units: Stage duration fields are seconds; raw receipt uses milliseconds. Telemetry units are in field names.
stage_semantics: Host wall and calling-thread CPU; PR459 threads overlap; compare per-thread partitions, never add thread lifetimes. Current Windows CPU is null. Independent stage medians need not sum to median worker lifetime.
receipt_storage: Windows original CRLF converted to LF for Git; JSON content unchanged. raw_receipt_sha256/raw_sha256 identify the original remote file; stored_receipt_sha256 identifies windows-compute-1cd0c881.json in this repository.
